warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-3'-4-5-6-7 at 2.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 + 1.00 + 1.00 + 2.00 + 3.00 (14.00); y = A-B-C-D-E-F-G at 2.00 + 1.00 + 3.00 + 1.00 + 2.00 + 2.00 (11.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-04 and (x) A-07 / (y) A-08; S-03 prints the 2-7 / A-E part. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

3' is a PRINTED grid bubble (③') at 7.00 on S-01..S-04 and A-07, so it is a named line. The dummy at 6.50 (S-01/S-02/S-03 sub-chain 3 +1.50 +0.50 = 3') would be 3' by the rule (primed off 3, the main grid to its left) — that name is taken by the printed line, so it is named 3'', the next free prime on 3 (tools/gridfix.py convention for a stranded tick). Its primes are therefore out of reading order on the 3 base (check_format NOTE) — deliberate, the printed name is never renamed (section 4).

4' (8.50) and 5'' (10.50) are not printed anywhere: they are the two ends of the higher ridge (อกไก่ +6.01) and the two king posts (ดั่ง 2C-150x50x20x3.2) standing on ring beam RB1 C'4-C'6. Measured by proportion against the grid (section 4 Span amendment 2026-08-29) on three sheets that agree — S-03 posts, S-04 ridge ends, A-07 posts — and consistent with 45-degree hips from the printed 1.00 eaves (15.00 - 4.50 = 10.50; 4.00 + 4.50 = 8.50). Per-line confidence 0.7, flag scaled_from_grid.

Eave lines: A' (-1.00) and 7' (15.00) are printed on S-04. The other two roof edges (x = 1.00 on the left, y = 8.00 along the south side, plus the 7.00 step at x = 4.00) are drawn on S-04 but not dimensioned on any swept sheet, so no line was made for them.
Two levels share the printed label ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+5.72 lower ridge, +6.01 higher ridge, both on A-07 and A-08) — the printed value is kept in each id to tell them apart.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus A-07 and A-08 (building sections, for levels and the x/y chains under them). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-09, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05 and S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, section sizes, slab thickness, step riser/tread), which stay on their elements.
